visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot of a white gashapon machine with a vibrant poster showcasing 'Retro PC Pouches' in several colors including yellow, pink, and green. The poster highlights the pouches' features like clear windows and miniature keyboard designs. (2) A young woman with dark hair and bangs, wearing a beige vest over a white top, stands in a brightly lit indoor hallway. She holds two plastic gashapon capsules, one yellow and one pink, towards the camera with a smile. (3) The woman struggles to remove clear adhesive tape from the yellow capsule, her facial expressions showing humorous effort. The setting appears to be a public transit hub or airport with blurred figures and blue signs in the background. (4) After opening the capsule, she pulls out a yellow fabric pouch shaped like a vintage computer monitor. She demonstrates the clear plastic screen and a small fabric keyboard attached to the front. (5) She points out a small round charm attached to the pouch that resembles a computer mouse with a piece of toast on it. The camera zooms in to capture the fine stitching and text details on the 'monitor' screen. (6) She slides a pixelated cardboard background into the pouch's window, transforming the internal space into a tiny bedroom. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the textures of the fabric. (7) She opens the pink capsule to reveal a pink version of the pouch featuring a 'livestream' interface with heart icons printed on the window. She uses her fingers to adjust the clear plastic. (8) The scene shifts to a closer framing where she demonstrates putting a small blue cat plush toy into the pouches. She also shows tiny food accessories like pearl milk tea and fried chicken. (9) In a final indoor setting with warmer, yellow-toned lighting (possibly a hotel room), the woman shows the pouches hanging from hooks. The pouches appear smoother, and she explains they were reshaped using a hairdryer.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy female voice begins narration with bright, fast speech patterns over a driving uptempo electronic pop track. The acoustic environment includes soft indoor reverberation of a public space. (2) A sharp mechanical click sound is heard as the first capsule is shown, followed by loud, high-frequency plastic rustling as the speaker struggles with the adhesive tape. (3) The female voice expresses exaggerated frustration with rising pitch intonations while the BGM maintains a steady, synthesized 4/4 beat. (4) Soft, dull thuds and fabric handling noises are audible as she pulls out the cloth pouch. The vocal tone becomes more descriptive and informative with high clarity. (5) A digital 'whoosh' sound effect marks a visual cut, transitioning the audio into a more detailed explanation of the pouch's textures. (6) Incidental sounds of paper sliding and cardboard rustling occur as the background inserts are placed. The BGM melody continues with a cheerful, repetitive synthesizer loop. (7) Ambient noise floor shifts to a quieter studio-like room tone as the speaker discusses the hotel room adjustments. The voice remains consistent in pitch and friendly tone. (8) Soft percussive impacts and tiny squeaks occur as plushies are placed inside the pouch. The audio ends with a high-pitched ding sound effect synchronized with the final caption.
